predictions.title: MWE-202: Insecure Token Buying Behavior
predictions.description: Buying tokens via swap or AMM can be manipulated to cause sandwich attacks.
predictions.impact: An attacker may manipulate the execution price around a token purchase, causing the buyer to receive fewer tokens or pay more than intended while the attacker captures the price difference. Actual exploitability requires further verification.
predictions.mitigation: Do not use swap or AMM to buy tokens.
predictions.report_basis: rule-template; not an LLM-generated exploit proof
